name: Dev Squad
description: Spins up a full AI dev team to implement GitHub issues end-to-end and deliver a PR
longDescription:
Ships **8 agents** and **1 command**.

- **Agents** (8): `backend-dev` (Senior backend developer — implements server-side features including APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations), `code-reviewer` (Senior code reviewer — audits the full changeset for correctness, security, performance, and adherence to codebase conventions), `database-engineer` (Database engineer — designs schema changes, writes migrations, optimizes queries, and manages seed data), `devops-engineer` (DevOps engineer — handles CI/CD configuration, environment variables, Dockerfiles, and deployment scripts), `documentation-writer` (Technical writer — updates README, API docs, inline comments, and changelogs to reflect new features), `frontend-dev` (Senior frontend developer — implements UI components, client-side logic, API integration, and styling), `playwright-engineer` (Test automation engineer — writes Playwright end-to-end tests that validate acceptance criteria through the UI), `ticket-analyst` (Reads a GitHub issue, clarifies requirements, and produces structured acceptance criteria and agent task assignments for the tech…)
- **Commands** (1): `dev-squad` (AI dev squad — reads a GitHub issue, plans the work, delegates to specialized agents, and opens a…)

Installs with `claude plugin install dev-squad@claude-community` from `briannaworkman/dev-squad-plugin`.
